personality_one_liner: A warm, joyful, and deeply personal digital home that feels like a shared family scrapbook crossed with a premium organizer.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding around content. Rely on playful chunky layouts. Avoid accidental empty space; use intentional padding to frame items.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers over the family feed.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use glass on 'Send Some Love' affection overlay backdrops.
dont's: Do not use glass on chore list rows or shopping list items.
Do not blur standard form fields or text regions.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A welcoming dashboard summarizing the day's events, unread affection/messages, and a feed of recent family moments.

states.loading: Centered playful spinner with a warm greeting.
states.empty: Illustration of a family tree with a 'Welcome home! Add your first memory' CTA.
states.error: Friendly error text 'Oops, couldn't load the living room' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Top: Large greeting 'Good Morning, Dad ❤️' (displayFontFamily). Below it: A horizontally scrolling 'Quick Actions' row of pills (Hug, Message, Post) using brandPrimary. Center: 'Today's Plan' with chunky stacked cards for chores/meals. Bottom: Vertical scrolling Family Feed with full-width image cards (must use gradient scrims for overlaid text).

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Shared family schedule showing who is doing what, color-coded by family member.

states.empty: No events today illustration (blank notebook) + 'Add Event' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top month/week toggle. Grid of days below. Events are represented by rounded pill chips with the specific family member's assigned color (e.g. Coral, Mustard, Olive). Touching an event opens a glassmorphic bottom sheet with details.

screens.name: Chores & Shopping
screens.purpose: Playful checklist for kids' chores and family groceries.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty plate (for groceries) or a clean room (for chores) + primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load lists + Retry button.

screens.layout: Two-tab layout (Chores / Shopping). Lists use large touch targets (min 56pt height). Checked items visually strike-through and fade to onSurfaceTertiary. Incorporate playful star icons (⭐) or badges for completed kid chores.

screens.name: Affection Center (Overlay/Modal)
screens.purpose: The signature 'Send Some Love' interaction to send hugs/kisses to members.
screens.layout: Full-screen glassmorphic overlay. Large member avatars in a grid. Once a member is selected, show floating reaction emojis (❤️, 🤗, 😘) using Reanimated. Tapping one triggers haptics and a full-screen confetti/hearts animation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere STRICTLY to the '4 Tactile / Playful' personality. Use chunky rounded cards (radius lg or pill) and playful asymmetric or stacked layouts for a warm, family-friendly feel.

BANNED COLORS: Do not use ANY shades of Blue, Purple, Indigo, or Violet. Stick entirely to the provided warm earth/botanical/coral palette. Member colors should be mapped to Coral, Mustard, Olive, and Sage.
Typography: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for strong, friendly headings, and 'Nunito' for highly legible and playful body text. Max weight is 500 across the app.

Affection Center: This is the signature feature. Build a robust `react-native-reanimated` overlay for 'Send Some Love' that includes floating emojis, haptics, and a full-screen immersive feel when an affection type is chosen.
Image Scrims: Any text placed on top of the Family Feed images or Avatars MUST use a vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Navigation: Implement a standard 5-tab bottom navigation with glassmorphism. Avoid floating tabs if they compromise the safe area.
